games.title: Grand Mafia Gangster City Game
games.heroSummary: Enter a massive 3D open-world crime city where you complete dangerous missions, fight rival gangs, escape police, drive powerful vehicles, control territory, and rise through the underworld toward becoming a mafia boss.
games.description: Grand Mafia Gangster City Game is an open-world crime experience built around city exploration, gangster missions, driving, combat, police chases, and mafia progression. Explore skyscrapers, highways, dark alleys, industrial areas, and hidden districts while taking on robberies, shootouts, turf wars, and other story-based missions. Steal and drive supercars, bikes, trucks, armored vehicles, and helicopters, then use pistols, rifles, shotguns, snipers, and explosives against rival gangs. Recruit gang members, expand your territory, earn cash, grow your influence, unlock perks, and build your mafia empire across a detailed 3D city.
games.screenshotIntro: Take a closer look at the open-world city, vehicles, missions, weapons, police pursuits, gang conflicts, and 3D action.

features.title: Open World City
features.description: Roam freely through a detailed gangster city filled with skyscrapers, highways, dark alleys, industrial areas, and hidden districts. Explore different parts of the open world while discovering missions, challenges, secrets, and criminal activity across the city.

features.title: Crime Missions
features.description: Take on story-based missions involving robberies, car chases, shootouts, turf wars, rival gangs, and police escapes. Each challenge pushes your progression forward as you build influence and work your way toward becoming a powerful mafia boss.

features.title: Cars and Combat
features.description: Steal and drive supercars, bikes, trucks, armored vehicles, and helicopters. Race, drift, perform stunts, and escape police pursuits while using pistols, rifles, shotguns, sniper weapons, explosives, and other weapons during third-person combat.

features.title: Mafia Empire
features.description: Recruit gang members, expand your territory, control crime zones, earn cash, grow your influence, and unlock powerful perks. Gang wars and territory control form part of your rise through the mafia ranks as your criminal empire spreads across the city.

cta.heading: Ready to Rule the City?
cta.description: Explore the open world, take on dangerous missions, steal and drive vehicles, fight rival gangs, escape police pursuits, control territory, and build your mafia empire.

games.title: Agent For Hire: Suit Shooter
games.heroSummary: Step into stylish 3D shooter action as an elite agent where fast gunfights, tactical movement, precision, and cinematic chaos shape every mission. Track your targets, strike with purpose, clean up, and suit up.
games.description: Agent For Hire: Suit Shooter puts you in the role of a professional contract killer in a 3D action shooter built around fast gunfights, tactical movement, and stealth. Plan each move, track dangerous targets, strike with precision, and stay unseen when the mission demands it. Take on sniper challenges, PvE encounters, and high-pressure agent hunts while using pistols, rifles, shotguns, and sniper weapons across changing combat situations. Some missions also push you to clean up crime scenes after the action. Timing, aim, positioning, and quick reactions shape how you handle each assignment and survive every intense shootout alive.
games.screenshotIntro: Take a closer look at the missions, environments, weapons, targets, stealth moments, and 3D shooter action.

features.title: Tactical Movement
features.description: Approach encounters with timing, positioning, and controlled movement rather than relying only on direct firepower. The tactical shooter gameplay gives you room to plan how you enter a fight, react to threats, and move through each dangerous assignment.

features.title: Stealth Missions
features.description: Stay unseen when the situation allows, eliminate targets carefully, and clean up crime scenes as part of the mission flow. The stealth game elements reward patience and precision as you strike, reposition, and avoid unnecessary exposure.

features.title: Weapon Variety
features.description: Use pistols, rifles, shotguns, and sniper weapons across different combat situations. Close-range shotgun action, handgun precision, and sniper shooter challenges give you different ways to handle enemies depending on the mission and distance.

features.title: Agent Hunts
features.description: Take on assassination missions, hunt dangerous targets, survive waves of enemies, and push through high-stakes operations. Spy agent game elements combine with PvE shooting and target tracking as every assignment demands accuracy, timing, and quick decisions.

cta.heading: Ready to Take the Contract?
cta.description: Suit up, enter the mission, track your target, and prove your precision across tactical assignments built around stealth and shooter action.

games.title: Doppelganger or Neighbor Game
games.heroSummary: Take the security desk in a suspenseful 2D horror simulation where dangerous doppelgangers hide among ordinary residents. Watch closely, question what feels wrong, and decide who can be trusted before an impostor slips through.
games.description: Doppelganger or Neighbor Game is a retro 2D horror world with deception and suspicious visitors, where you play as a vigilant security guard. Check IDs. Interrogate residents. Compare details. Watch behaviour closely. Who is human? Who might be a doppelganger? Logic, memory, camera footage, Polaroid images - anything that can be used to find inconsistencies before letting anyone in. The first-person simulation blends detective-style inspection with psychological horror, a Cold War-era atmosphere, progressive difficulty, and multiple endings shaped by the choices you make during each tense shift at your guarded building.
games.screenshotIntro: Take a closer look at suspicious visitors, identity documents, camera evidence, retro environments, and the clues that can reveal who is hiding behind a familiar face.

features.title: Identity Inspection
features.description: Examine IDs, compare details, question residents, and watch for unusual behavior before allowing anyone inside. Small inconsistencies can expose a doppelganger, making attention to detail and careful judgment central to every encounter.

features.title: Camera Evidence
features.description: Capture suspicious visitors with the camera and study Polaroid images for details that may not be obvious at first glance. Use visual evidence alongside documents and conversations to identify inconsistencies before making your decision.

features.title: Retro Horror
features.description: Enter a Cold War-era world presented through retro 2D graphics and unsettling sound design. The atmosphere leans into psychological horror and suspense, creating tension through uncertainty, strange behavior, and the fear that someone familiar may not be human.

features.title: Choices & Endings
features.description: Your decisions shape how the shift unfolds and can lead to multiple endings. As the difficulty increases, doppelgangers adapt and become harder to identify, forcing you to rely on logic, memory, observation, and everything you have learned from earlier encounters.

deviceRequirements.title: Windows Availability
items: Google Play Games on PC required

cta.heading: Can You Tell Who Is Real?
cta.description: Take your place at the security desk and make every decision count. One visitor may look familiar, but not everyone standing at the door is who they claim to be.

recommended.os: Android 7.1 and up / Windows via Google Play Games

games.title: Midnight Shift: Doppelganger
games.heroSummary: Enter a haunting 3D supermarket horror game where an ordinary night shift turns into something far more disturbing. Manage the store after dark while strange customers, supernatural events, and a hidden doppelganger turn routine work into a fight to survive.
games.description: Midnight Shift: Doppelganger drops you into a 3D supermarket horror experience where an ordinary graveyard shift slowly turns into something disturbing. As eerie whispers, flickering lights, ghostly shadows, and supernatural events threaten to take over, serve customers, run the register, restock shelves, manage store tasks and keep the shop running. What starts as a familiar supermarket simulator soon becomes a tense mystery centred on a sinister doppelganger. Watch customers closely, handle each task under pressure, and survive a night where even your own reflection may not be easy to trust. Each aisle could hide another warning.
games.screenshotIntro: Take a closer look at the supermarket, cashier station, customers, dark aisles, strange events, and unsettling moments that unfold during the midnight shift.

features.title: Supermarket Shift
features.description: Handle everyday store responsibilities, including serving customers, operating the cash register, restocking shelves, managing inventory, and keeping the supermarket functioning while working through the night.

features.title: Haunted Store
features.description: Explore a grocery store where flickering lights, eerie whispers, ghostly shadows, and supernatural activity gradually change the atmosphere. Familiar aisles become increasingly unsettling as the shift moves deeper into the night.

features.title: Doppelganger Mystery
features.description: Watch the people entering the store and uncover the mystery surrounding a sinister double. The doppelganger element adds suspicion to customer encounters as you try to identify whether the person in front of you is really human.

features.title: Horror Management
features.description: The game blends supermarket simulation with horror and management gameplay. Complete retail tasks while responding to disturbing events, controlling the store, and trying to survive a graveyard shift where even familiar surroundings can no longer be trusted.

deviceRequirements.title: Windows Availability
items: Google Play Games on PC required

cta.heading: Can You Survive the Midnight Shift?
cta.description: Keep the store running as the night grows stranger, uncover what is hiding among your customers, and make it through the shift before the supermarket becomes something you cannot escape.

recommended.os: Android 7.1 and up / Windows via Google Play Games

games.title: Last Survivor Left: Zombie War
games.heroSummary: Fight, craft, and survive in a brutal 3D open-world PvE island where civilization has fallen. Search hostile zones, face infected threats, gather what you need, and push deeper into an unforgiving zombie apocalypse.
games.description: Last Survivor Left: Zombie War drops you into a brutal 3D open-world PvE survival challenge where every choice can decide how long you stay alive. Explore hostile island zones, gather resources, craft what you need, and fight through forests, wastelands, and zombie-infested areas after civilization falls. Face hordes, survive intense shooting encounters, hunt monsters, and push through doomsday conditions while managing limited supplies. The game blends island survival, crafting, exploration, and FPS-style 3D combat into a post-apocalyptic experience where preparation, movement, and survival skills matter with every step you take.
games.screenshotIntro: Take a closer look at the island, wilderness, apocalyptic zones, zombie encounters, weapons, resources, and survival environments.

features.title: Survival Crafting
features.description: Search the environment for useful resources and materials, then use survival crafting to prepare for what comes next. Progress depends on how well you gather supplies, manage what you find, and stay ready for the dangers waiting beyond safer areas.

features.title: Zombie Warfare
features.description: Face infected enemies through zombie shooting encounters and survival firefights. Horde battles and large groups of enemies increase the pressure, turning open areas into dangerous combat zones where aim, movement, and survival instincts matter.

features.title: Island Exploration
features.description: Travel across a 3D open world that stretches from wilderness and forests to hostile wastelands and post-apocalyptic areas. Different zones bring new dangers, resources, monster encounters, and reasons to continue exploring beyond familiar ground.

features.title: PvE Survival
features.description: Take on PvE challenges built around surviving hostile environments, enemies, and the aftermath of the outbreak. The game combines FPS survival action, doomsday survival pressure, monster hunts, and ongoing survival challenges as you fight to remain the last survivor.

cta.heading: How Long Can You Stay Alive?
cta.description: Enter the island with nothing guaranteed. Build your survival skills, explore what remains of the world, and see how far you can make it when every day brings another threat.
